namespace App\Services;

use App\DTO\OwnerDTO;
use App\Models\Owner;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;

class OwnerService
{
    private const FILTERS = ['id', 'name'];

    private const SORTS = ['id', 'name', 'created_at', 'updated_at'];

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $query  filter[field]=value, sort=field,-field, page, per_page
     */
    public function paginate(array $query = []): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $builder = Owner::query();

        foreach ((array) ($query['filter'] ?? []) as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, self::FILTERS, true)) {
                $builder->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        $sorts = array_filter(
            explode(',', is_string($query['sort'] ?? null) ? $query['sort'] : ''),
            fn (string $sort) => in_array(ltrim($sort, '-'), self::SORTS, true)
        );

        foreach ($sorts ?: ['-id'] as $sort) {
            $builder->orderBy(ltrim($sort, '-'), str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        }

        $perPage = is_numeric($query['per_page'] ?? null) ? min(max((int) $query['per_page'], 1), 100) : 15;

        return $builder->paginate($perPage, ['*'], 'page', max((int) ($query['page'] ?? 1), 1))->withQueryString();
    }

    public function create(OwnerDTO $dto): Owner
    {
        return Owner::create($dto->toArray());
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Owner
    {
        return Owner::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Owner $owner, OwnerDTO $dto): Owner
    {
        $owner->update($dto->toArray());

        return $owner->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Owner $owner): bool
    {
        return $owner->delete();
    }
}

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreOwnerRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateOwnerRequest;

readonly class OwnerDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $name = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreOwnerRequest|UpdateOwnerRequest $request): self
    {
        return self::fromArray($request->validated());
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data  validated input, whatever sent it
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            name: isset($data['name']) ? (string) $data['name'] : null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Owner;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Tests\TestCase;

class OwnerControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_can_list_owners(): void
    {
        Owner::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/owners?per_page=2');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonCount(2, 'data')
            ->assertJsonPath('meta.total', 3);
    }

    public function test_can_filter_owners(): void
    {
        $value = Owner::factory()->count(3)->create()->first()->getRawOriginal('name');

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/owners?'.http_build_query(['filter' => ['name' => $value]]));

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonPath('meta.total', Owner::where('name', $value)->count());
    }

    public function test_can_sort_owners(): void
    {
        Owner::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/owners?sort=id');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.0.id', Owner::query()->orderBy('id')->value('id'));
    }

    public function test_can_create_owner(): void
    {
        $data = [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ];

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/owners', $data);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('owners', [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_owner(): void
    {
        $owner = Owner::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/owners/{$owner->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['id' => $owner->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_owner(): void
    {
        $owner = Owner::factory()->create();
        $data = [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ];

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/owners/{$owner->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('owners', [
            'name' => 'test_name',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_can_patch_owner(): void
    {
        $owner = Owner::factory()->create()->fresh();

        $response = $this->patchJson("/api/owners/{$owner->getKey()}", ['name' => 'test_name']);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('owners', ['id' => $owner->getKey(), 'name' => 'test_name']);
        $this->assertSame(
            Arr::except($owner->getAttributes(), ['name', 'updated_at']),
            Arr::except($owner->fresh()->getAttributes(), ['name', 'updated_at'])
        );
    }

    public function test_can_delete_owner(): void
    {
        $owner = Owner::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/owners/{$owner->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('owners', ['id' => $owner->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_create_owner_validates_required_fields(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/owners', []);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\DTO\OwnerDTO;
use App\Models\Owner;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class OwnerServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private OwnerService $service;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->service = new OwnerService;
    }

    public function test_can_paginate_owners(): void
    {
        Owner::factory()->count(5)->create();

        $result = $this->service->paginate(['per_page' => 2]);

        $this->assertSame(5, $result->total());
        $this->assertCount(2, $result->items());
    }

    public function test_can_filter_owners(): void
    {
        $value = Owner::factory()->count(3)->create()->first()->getRawOriginal('name');

        $result = $this->service->paginate(['filter' => ['name' => $value]]);

        $this->assertSame(Owner::where('name', $value)->count(), $result->total());
    }

    public function test_can_create_owner(): void
    {
        $dto = new OwnerDTO(
            name: 'test_name',
        );

        $owner = $this->service->create($dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Owner::class, $owner);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('owners', 1);
    }

    public function test_can_find_owner(): void
    {
        $owner = Owner::factory()->create();

        $found = $this->service->find($owner->getKey());

        $this->assertEquals($owner->getKey(), $found->getKey());
    }

    public function test_can_update_owner(): void
    {
        $owner = Owner::factory()->create();
        $dto = new OwnerDTO(
            name: 'test_name',
        );

        $updated = $this->service->update($owner, $dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Owner::class, $updated);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_owner(): void
    {
        $owner = Owner::factory()->create();

        $result = $this->service->delete($owner);

        $this->assertTrue($result);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('owners', 0);
    }
}

            'per_page' => $schema->integer()->min(1)->max(100),

#[Name('update-owner')]
#[Description('Updates a owner. Only the fields sent are changed.')]
#[IsIdempotent]
#[IsOpenWorld(false)]
class UpdateOwnerTool extends Tool
{
    public function handle(Request $request, OwnerService $owners): Response|ResponseFactory
    {
        $owner = Owner::find($request->validate(['id' => ['required', 'integer']])['id']);

        if ($owner === null) {
            return Response::error('Owner not found.');
        }

        Gate::authorize('update', $owner);

        $owner = $owners->update($owner, OwnerDTO::fromArray($request->validate($this->rules($owner))));

        return Response::structured((new OwnerResource($owner))->response()->getData(true));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function rules(Owner $owner): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => 'sometimes|required|string|max:255',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, Type>
     */
    public function schema(JsonSchema $schema): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $schema->integer()->required(),
            'name' => $schema->string(),
        ];
    }
}

use App\Http\Requests\StoreTicketRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateTicketRequest;
use App\Http\Resources\TicketResource;
use App\Models\Ticket;
use App\Services\TicketService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

class TicketController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly TicketService $service
    ) {}

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('viewAny', Ticket::class);

        $tickets = $this->service->paginate($request->query());

        return TicketResource::collection($tickets);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(StoreTicketRequest $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('create', Ticket::class);

        $dto = TicketDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $ticket = $this->service->create($dto);

        return new TicketResource($ticket);
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(Ticket $ticket)
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $ticket);

        return new TicketResource($ticket);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(UpdateTicketRequest $request, Ticket $ticket)
    {

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\DTO\TicketDTO;
use App\Models\Ticket;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;

class TicketService
{
    private const FILTERS = ['id', 'code', 'subject', 'priority', 'due_on', 'owner_id'];

    private const SORTS = ['id', 'code', 'subject', 'priority', 'due_on', 'owner_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at'];

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $query  filter[field]=value, sort=field,-field, page, per_page
     */
    public function paginate(array $query = []): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $builder = Ticket::query();

        foreach ((array) ($query['filter'] ?? []) as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, self::FILTERS, true)) {
                $builder->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        $sorts = array_filter(
            explode(',', is_string($query['sort'] ?? null) ? $query['sort'] : ''),
            fn (string $sort) => in_array(ltrim($sort, '-'), self::SORTS, true)
        );

        foreach ($sorts ?: ['-id'] as $sort) {
            $builder->orderBy(ltrim($sort, '-'), str_starts_with($sort, '-') ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        }

        $perPage = is_numeric($query['per_page'] ?? null) ? min(max((int) $query['per_page'], 1), 100) : 15;

        return $builder->paginate($perPage, ['*'], 'page', max((int) ($query['page'] ?? 1), 1))->withQueryString();
    }

    public function create(TicketDTO $dto): Ticket
    {
        return Ticket::create($dto->toArray());
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Ticket
    {
        return Ticket::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Ticket $ticket, TicketDTO $dto): Ticket
    {
        $ticket->update($dto->toArray());

        return $ticket->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Ticket $ticket): bool
    {
        return $ticket->delete();
    }

    public function restore(Ticket $ticket): Ticket
    {
        $ticket->restore();

        return $ticket;
    }

    public function forceDelete(Ticket $ticket): bool
    {
        return $ticket->forceDelete();
    }
}

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreTicketRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateTicketRequest;

readonly class TicketDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $code = null,
        public ?string $subject = null,
        public ?string $priority = null,
        public ?string $due_on = null,
        public ?array $meta = null,
        public ?int $owner_id = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreTicketRequest|UpdateTicketRequest $request): self
    {
        return self::fromArray($request->validated());
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data  validated input, whatever sent it
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            code: isset($data['code']) ? (string) $data['code'] : null,
            subject: isset($data['subject']) ? (string) $data['subject'] : null,
            priority: isset($data['priority']) ? (string) $data['priority'] : null,
            due_on: isset($data['due_on']) ? (string) $data['due_on'] : null,
            meta: isset($data['meta']) ? (is_array($data['meta']) ? $data['meta'] : (array) json_decode($data['meta'], true)) : null,
            owner_id: isset($data['owner_id']) ? (int) $data['owner_id'] : null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}

            ->assertJsonPath('data.0.id', Ticket::query()->orderBy('id')->value('id'));

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('tickets', [
            'code' => 'test_code',
            'owner_id' => $owner->getKey(),
        ]);

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/tickets/{$ticket->getKey()}");

            ->assertJsonFragment(['id' => $ticket->getKey()]);
    }

        $data = [
            'owner_id' => $ticket->owner_id,
            'code' => 'test_code',
            'subject' => 'test_subject',
            'priority' => 'low',
            'due_on' => '2025-01-01 00:00:00',
            'meta' => ['key' => 'value'],

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/tickets/{$ticket->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('tickets', [

    }

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

            return Response::error('Ticket not found.');

        Gate::authorize('delete', $ticket);

        $tickets->delete($ticket);

        return Response::text('Ticket deleted.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, Type>
     */
    public function schema(JsonSchema $schema): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $schema->integer()->required(),
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Mcp\Tools\Ticket;

use App\Http\Resources\TicketResource;
use App\Models\Ticket;
use App\Services\TicketService;
use Illuminate\Contracts\JsonSchema\JsonSchema;
use Illuminate\JsonSchema\Types\Type;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Laravel\Mcp\Request;
use Laravel\Mcp\Response;
use Laravel\Mcp\ResponseFactory;
use Laravel\Mcp\Server\Attributes\Description;
use Laravel\Mcp\Server\Attributes\Name;
use Laravel\Mcp\Server\Tool;
use Laravel\Mcp\Server\Tools\Annotations\IsDestructive;
use Laravel\Mcp\Server\Tools\Annotations\IsIdempotent;
use Laravel\Mcp\Server\Tools\Annotations\IsOpenWorld;

#[Name('restore-ticket')]
#[Description('Brings a deleted ticket back from the trash.')]
#[IsDestructive(false)]
#[IsIdempotent]
#[IsOpenWorld(false)]
class RestoreTicketTool extends Tool
{
    public function handle(Request $request, TicketService $tickets): Response|ResponseFactory
    {
        $ticket = Ticket::withTrashed()->find($request->validate(['id' => ['required', 'integer']])['id']);

        if ($ticket === null) {
            return Response::error('Ticket not found.');
        }

        Gate::authorize('restore', $ticket);

        return Response::structured((new TicketResource($tickets->restore($ticket)))->response()->getData(true));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, Type>
     */
    public function schema(JsonSchema $schema): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => $schema->integer()->required(),
        ];
    }
}
